sources.excerpt: Published on March 3, 2025 Wampler Pedals overdrive pedal Information Wampler Pedals The Germanium Tumnus Deluxe adds vintage sizzle and extra bite to a classic pedal, with increased options for gain switching, three band EQ, and switchable buffer. "This is my shot at the ultimate Klon-style overdrive…​" Legendary Diodes, Iconic Tone There are so many Klones out there that it's hard to keep up. That's just fine with me. My original Tumnus is still a favorite of guitarists around the world. That said, they're nearly all missing the unique germanium diodes that powered Bill Finnegan's classic design. Not so with the Germanium Tumnus Deluxe. I found an exceedingly rare stash of germanium diodes electronically identical to the ones Finnegan used. Thanks to them, the Germanium Tumnus Deluxe is as close as you can get to his '90s icons. That Tone With Any Rig, Every Time The Germanium Tumnus Deluxe and the sold-out Germanium Tumnus are essentially the same circuits. The Deluxe's 3-band EQ just gives you finer control without losing the pedal's inherent character. Want to add a bit of low-end back into the mix? Need some extra cut and attack? How about boosting a crunchy amp with a tighter, more percussive sound? It's all there, and it's all authentic. More Gain With the Flip of a Switch The Germanium Tumnus Deluxe also features my "hot switch," which introduces more output and drive than most Klones. That includes my my OG Tumnus. This style of pedal is already a quintessential clean boost and mid-gain overdrive. Now, it has a meaner side while retaining the classic vocal-like tone and throaty response you expect. To Buffer or Not to Buffer This style of overdrive pedal gives your tone more clarity and character. It's often used as an always-on tonal sweetener but still adds some magic when bypassed. Still, there are plenty of us who want our pedals entirely out of the way when not in use. That's why I gave the Germanium Tumnus Deluxe a side-mounted buffer-bypass toggle switch. Keep it on for a bit of sparkle, or flip it off for an unadulterated signal path. Your choice. Technical Details Built in the U.S.A. Special edition of Wampler's best selling Tumnus Deluxe overdrive Premium textured Alien Silver" finish and anodized controls Vintage-specification clipping diodes for extra bite and sizzle High-grade components selected for their superior sound and response Battery connection and 9v power jack (this pedal runs at 9v ONLY) Same incredible tone as the Tumnus, but with added features Normal / Hot switch… adds a little extra when the pedal is being pushed into higher gain Buffered or True Bypass Full 3 band EQ Top-mounted jacks make pedalboard placement effortless Power draw: 80mA @ 9V (LED will flash 3 times when power from battery is getting low) Includes Wampler's limited 5-year warranty 2.50″ x 4.50″ x 1.5″ (63.5mm x 114.3mm x 38.1mm) - height excludes knobs and switches Limited Edition, You Know the Drill! I only have a limited supply of those vintage diodes, so this pedal won't be around long. If you're curious, move quick. You won't regret it.
